standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of an invertible sheaf of prescribed degree with a vanishing first cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the auxiliary invertible module N of degree g - 1.

core_obligations: Take the invertible module N produced by the general degree lemma for line bundles and compute its degree as chi(X, N) - chi(X, O_X) = 0 - (1 - g) = g - 1 (proof lines 8160-8163).
Deduce deg(L tensor N^{tensor -1}) = deg(L) - (g-1) >= g and hence chi(X, L tensor N^{tensor -1}) >= 1 (proof lines 8164-8167).

Conclude that there is a nonzero global section whose zero scheme is an effective Cartier divisor D of degree deg(L) - (g-1), giving the short exact sequence 0 -> N -> L -> i_*(L|_D) -> 0 (proof lines 8168-8173).

From that sequence obtain that H^0(X, L) maps isomorphically to H^0(D, L|_D), which has dimension deg(L) - (g-1), and deduce the vanishing of H^1(X, L) from the definition of the degree (proof lines 8174-8177).
proof_roadmap: Produce an auxiliary invertible sheaf of degree g - 1 and twist by its inverse.
Use the positivity of the Euler characteristic to find an effective divisor.
Compare sections through the exact sequence of that divisor.
Read the vanishing off the degree computation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves H^1(X, L) = 0 for every invertible sheaf of degree at least 2g - 1 on a proper curve over an algebraically closed field, where g = dim_k H^1(X, O_X). The proof takes the invertible module N supplied by the general degree lemma for line bundles, computes its degree as chi(X, N) - chi(X, O_X) = g - 1, and hence finds deg(L tensor N^{-1}) >= g, so that its Euler characteristic is at least one (proof lines 8160-8167). That yields a nonzero global section whose zero scheme is an effective Cartier divisor D of degree deg(L) - (g - 1); the resulting short exact sequence 0 -> N -> L -> i_*(L|_D) -> 0 identifies H^0(X, L) with H^0(D, L|_D), whose dimension is deg(L) - (g - 1), and the result follows from the definition of degree (proof lines 8168-8177). H2: the degree bookkeeping through the auxiliary line bundle and the short exact sequence computation are the substance.
